ownership.contract_and_verifier: lotus-platform identity and access governance (this repository)
ownership.grant_store_implementation: lotus-platform identity and access governance: a platform identity capability behind the injected GrantStore port of automation/verify_principal_credential.py, to be hosted by a dedicated Lotus identity service once one is designated. It is not a domain service's table. Until it exists, resolution answers grant_store_unavailable, which is a published denial.
ownership.grant_store_operations: The bank security authority / identity-provider operator: issuer provisioning, key custody and rotation, the membership source of record, and revocation feeds. External and unclaimed; nothing in this repository is evidence of it.

declined.lotus-core: 2026-09-08: portfolio_party_role_assignments and portfolio-manager-book memberships are financial business relationships, not authentication tenant grants; Core consumes the verified decision and fails closed when it is unavailable. Recorded on #775.

accepted_by.lotus-workbench: 2026-09-08 consumer response on #775: Core's decline accepted as the correct domain boundary; Platform to publish the corrected owner.

ownership.premise_corrected: RFC-0109 originally assigned the store to 'the service that owns tenant membership' and asserted membership 'already has one'. Measured across all thirteen repositories on 2026-09-07: no repository defines a tenants or tenant-membership table. Tenant admission (scoping rows by an admitted tenant id) is not tenant membership (verifying the caller belongs to that tenant).

pilot.why_this_pilot: The BFF is the delegated shape RFC-0109 requires rather than permits, it already consumed the signed vectors, JWKS, revocation inputs and verifier delivered by #850/#854, and its merged slice is on main. Gateway (composition front door) is the second adopter and a domain service the third; neither is claimed here.

finite_acceptance.proof: present_but_unverified is refused by real signature verification, and the same bytes verify once the key is trusted
tenant_not_a_member is refused, resolved rather than read from the credential
portfolio_outside_scope is refused rather than narrowed
grant_store_unavailable is a denial, never an empty grant set, and an absent resolver refuses rather than skips
one admitted delegated call resolves to the intersection of application and person grants
zero protected upstream calls on any denial
finite_acceptance.note: A fixture property (maxProtectedOperationCalls: 0 on every denial fixture); provable only at the consumer, against a recording client.

finite_acceptance.proof: browser-supplied authority is refused and never projected
finite_acceptance.note: Consumer-side by construction; the admission fixture asserts a header-carried tenant and capability the resolved principal does not hold.

finite_acceptance.proof: principal change clears all protected client state

consumer_claims_note: 'claimed' means the consumer stated the proof on #775 and the named test files exist at consumer_proof_revision; this repository has not executed the consumer's suite and does not certify it. The consumer records its own evidence on lotus-workbench #436.
